finding_1_modelling_error.what: route_speed_limit sampled only NORMAL edge lanes. SUMO's INTERNAL junction lanes are much slower, and the abstraction therefore assumed a speed the vehicle is never permitted to reach while crossing a junction.
finding_1_modelling_error.correction: take the minimum over route edge lanes AND the internal lanes connecting them. This is the conservative bound the UNDER semantics always required; it is NOT a fitted margin.

finding_2_residual_mechanism.evidence_for: all three routes with ZERO traffic lights on the approach have a residual below 0.21 s; the most signalised map, washington_downtown with 4 to 8 lights per route, is uniformly large at 10.3 to 101.8 s
finding_2_residual_mechanism.evidence_against_a_count_based_rule: seattle routes 0, 1 and 2 all cross 2 lights and split 37.7 / 47.1 / 0.14 s; toronto routes 0 and 2 cross 3 and 5 lights with small residuals while route 1 crosses 2 with 8.5 s
finding_2_residual_mechanism.reading: count does not determine the outcome, because whether a vehicle is stopped depends on PHASE TIMING at the moment it arrives, not on how many signals it passes. This is the same reason the junction count in A-41 explained nothing.
finding_2_residual_mechanism.status: PLAUSIBLE AND UNCONFIRMED. No signal-phase trace was recorded; that would confirm it and is not done here.

effect_on_sealed_amendments.A-40: magnitudes INFLATED by the modelling error. Conclusion survives.
effect_on_sealed_amendments.A-41: '48 of 48 lost feasibility' becomes '10 of 12' once the model uses a speed the vehicle can actually reach. Median error 39.6 s becomes 4.35 s. The conclusion that no route arrives within tolerance SURVIVES.

consequence_for_the_windows_redesign: A signal hold is set by the signal program and is unbounded from the kinematic model's point of view. No kinematic bound absorbs it. A window-based SUPPORTED must either span the worst-case signal delay on the approach, or the model must read the signal program, or stations must be restricted to unsignalised approaches - and unlike the junction-free restriction closed by A-41, that last one has instances: three of twelve routes here.
not_established: that traffic lights are the residual cause; no phase trace was recorded
